description.message: Passwords from Unitool on your phone, filled into this computer's browser. You confirm every one on the phone.

notPaired.message: Pair a phone with Unitool to take passwords from it.

onlyWeb.message: Passwords are filled into web pages only (http and https).

firefoxAsk.message: Firefox may ask whether it may start Unitool — allow it.

searching.message: Looking for the phone… Open Passwords on the phone.

searchingHint.message: The phone and the computer must be on the same Wi-Fi.

found.message: Found the phone. The request is about to appear on it.

submitYourself.message: The form is not submitted — press Sign in yourself.

noField.message: No password field was found on the page.

tabChanged.message: The tab has left $VALUE$ — nothing is filled in there.

clipboardNote.message: While this window stays open, the password is cleared from the clipboard after 60 s. Close it sooner and it is not: after that the extension cannot touch the clipboard.

pairSteps.message: Unitool → Passwords → Computers → Pair a computer.

pairCheck.message: The phone will show "$VALUE$" and this SSH key — check they match:

err_host.message: Couldn't start Unitool on this computer. In a terminal: unitool browser install

err_host_firefox.message: Couldn't start Unitool on this computer. In a terminal: unitool browser install. In Firefox from snap, check that starting Unitool is allowed.

err_no_phone.message: The phone wasn't found within a minute. Open Passwords on the phone; the phone and the computer must be on the same Wi-Fi. On an iPhone, allow Unitool to use the local network.

err_phone_refused.message: The phone didn't recognise this computer. Pair it again.

err_bad_response.message: An answer came that doesn't fit this request. Nothing was filled in.

err_key.message: This computer's SSH key can't be read.

err_clock.message: The phone's and the computer's clocks differ by more than 5 minutes.

err_busy.message: The phone is showing another computer's request.

err_locked.message: Passwords isn't open on the phone.

err_origin.message: Passwords are filled into web pages only (http and https).
